content.short: BONAD is a token launchpad on Monad where creators launch tokens and earn trading fees.
content.description: BONAD is a launchpad on Monad where creators earn from the trading activity their token generates. Fees from each trade are shared back to the creator continuously, so the incentive follows sustained volume and not the launch alone. Tokens deploy and begin trading from the same interface.
content.meta: Create a token on Monad and take a share of the trading fees it generates afterwards.
